key_intermediates.destination_row_rule: Pack consecutive blocks left-to-right, ten per row, finishing each source sheet before moving to the next source sheet.

decoy_notes: Extracting only the first highlighted block leaves most of destination!A1:DQ8 blank.
Treating lap-* sheets as flat tables loses the relative cell-coordinate pattern.
Ignoring highlighted cells or merged-cell layout makes the 22-row block structure ambiguous.
Preserving the initial destination etc markers instead of applying the clarified packing rule leaves expected slots blank.
Using visual top-to-bottom order instead of the specified coordinate order swaps E9 with C11/C12-derived fields.
Completing only one workbook variant should fail delivery for the other variants.
